description: IDProtect is a cryptographic module based on the Athena OS755 Java Card smart card operating system. IDProtect is compliant with the latest Java Card 2.2.2 and Global Platform 2.1.1 specifications and FIPS 140-2 Level 3 (Level 4 Physical Security). IDProtect supports FIPS approved RNG, TDES, AES, SHA-1, SHA-256, and RSA up to 2048 bits.
